patch.note: 7.42 is the live gameplay patch, a big update that changes the economy (fixed passive gold), moves the Tormentor to 15 minutes, adds an Item Potency stat for on-hit items and reworks neutral camps and items.

events.name: BLAST Slam IX
events.format: Four GSL groups of four (Bo3, 20 to 23 Nov). Group winners play seeding matches, runners-up go to a last-chance stage, the rest are out. Double-elimination playoffs, Bo3, with a Bo5 grand final.

events.name: DreamLeague Season 30
events.format: Online event run by ESL, 2 to 13 Dec. A Swiss group stage of 24 teams with Bo3 series, then the top eight go to a double-elimination playoff with a Bo5 grand final. Some places are still to be filled by qualifiers.

events.name: PARI Universe
events.format: Two round-robin groups of five, then double-elimination playoffs (Bo3, Bo5 grand final).

news.title: DreamLeague S30 is a 24-team, $750,000 online event
news.text: Running 2 to 13 Dec, it uses a Swiss group stage then an eight-team double-elimination playoff. Several places are still to come from qualifiers.

news.title: Patch 7.42 is out with a new economy and Item Potency
news.text: Valve's first big patch since March fixes passive gold, moves the Tormentor to minute 15, adds an Item Potency stat for on-hit items, and reshuffles neutral camps and items.

news.title: BLAST Slam IX opening day has eight Bo3 series across two days
news.text: Yandex face PlayTime and Spirit meet Nemesis on 20 Nov, with NAVI vs OG, Liquid vs DO KONCA and others later that day. Aurora vs Astra Invicta and LGD vs 1win follow on 21 Nov.

news.title: BLAST Slam IX opens on 20 November with a 16-team online field
news.text: Four GSL groups of four play Bo3 from 20 to 23 Nov, then seeding matches, a last-chance stage and playoffs to 29 Nov. NAVI meet OG in Group A's opener.

news.title: Small client update adds a "Bot" report reason
news.text: A mini-patch on 13 Nov refreshed localisation files and added "Bot" as a reason when reporting a player. No gameplay changes.

news.title: 7.42 may land around DreamLeague S30, but it is only a rumour
news.text: Community talk links the next big patch to DreamLeague (2 to 13 Dec). Valve has said nothing official; a short-lived 7.41g entry and a client-only build are the only hints.

news.title: Still no date for 7.42
news.text: 7.41f (15 Sep) remains the live patch. 7.41 itself arrived on 24 Mar, which makes this one of the longest waits for a numbered patch.

news.title: Dark Willow is the most-picked hero in pro games
news.text: A pro meta report on 7.41f counted 38 picks for Dark Willow, more than any other hero.

news.title: BetBoom Team pauses its Dota 2 roster; four players regroup as DO KONCA
news.text: BetBoom moved its five-man lineup to inactive after weak results. Kiritych, Save, MieRo and Kataomi now play as DO KONCA, who are in BLAST Slam IX.

news.title: Team Spirit sweep Team Yandex to win PARI Universe
news.text: Spirit dropped to the lower bracket, came back through it and won the best-of-five grand final 3-0.

news.title: November update: Monkey King, Ability Draft and the end of 32-bit
news.text: Monkey King gets more things to transform into, Ability Draft now hands out scepter and shard abilities along with the base ones, lobbies can shuffle player slots, and Dota no longer runs on 32-bit systems.
